benefits.name: Enriching job experiences
benefits.details: We embody the Next-Gen work environment and culture while working with the world's best brands. Focused on next-gen capabilities in digital, engineering, cloud and AI, we work on a full spectrum of technology solutions.

benefits.name: Career opportunities on your terms
benefits.details: We want all our people to find their spark. We offer skill-based learning and mentoring at all levels and offer flexibility to pivot industry or role when ready. We value creation focused on our culture of Ideapreneurship.

benefits.name: An employment that you can trust in
benefits.details: We have an unwavering commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. At HCLTech, we provide our people with a fair opportunity to attain their full potential in an inclusive environment where they are valued and treated equally and with respect.

benefits.name: A diverse, international culture that values your whole self
benefits.details: We embrace a truly global culture. Several industry-leading programs on DEI, CSR and ESG engagements weave into our employees’ work-life integration. Our diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities makes us a dynamic and progressive workplace.
